systems.name: stub-agent
systems.notes: No model and no network: exercises the harness itself, so a green run here proves the runner works and nothing about model quality.

systems.name: local-http
systems.notes: Model-only baseline over the running llama-server: no agent scaffold, no tools.

systems.name: local-ponytail-off
systems.notes: dsh bench profile with the ponytail hook tier disabled by an overlay. One declared difference from the on-arm, so the lane-set delta is exactly the variable under test.

systems.name: local-ponytail-on
systems.notes: dsh bench profile with the ponytail hook tier enabled. Ponytail only injects prompt context; it never denies a tool call, so this measures context on/off, not enforcement.
